style: [HARMONY SYSTEM] quartal voicing and suspended harmonic fields floating over gospel extensions and delayed cadential release. [MELODIC SYSTEM] fast scat-like contour with clipped consonant attacks intersecting with yodel register flips and rapid ornamental turns. [RHYTHMIC SYSTEM] deep funk pocket with syncopated sixteenth-note displacement crashing into waltz pulse and sudden metric stops. [TIMBRE / ATMOSPHERE SYSTEM] gospel piano, organ swells, handclaps, fuzz guitar, cheap organ, tambourine, and acoustic room bleed. [PERFORMANCE ATTITUDE] ecstatic and physically committed theatrical overstatement delivered with absolute deadpan seriousness. [ANCHOR / INVARIANT] a relentless handclap pattern holding absolute time while everything else mutates and folds. [OPERATORS] hold handclap pattern fixed while rhythmic subdivisions migrate; compress vocal melody into single consonants; make gospel harmonies behave like mathematical matrices without losing soulful fervor; preserve funk pocket; force incompatible hyper-dimensional astral scales to coexist seamlessly.
lyrics:
[INTRO]
[Spoken Spoken Spoken]
Look at the geometric rhombic dodecahedron.
It has eyes. Millions of eyes.
It is spinning across the astral plane.
[Music Starts - Bright Gospel Funk Piano, Snapping Handclaps]
[Verse 1]
[Stacked Doo-Wop Vocables]
Oom-pah, oom-pah, tesseract wheels turn!
Biblically accurate angel burning in the fern!
Rhombic dodecahedron wings of prismatic glass,
Glittering gold feathers as the dimensions pass!
[Chorus]
[Massed Gospel Choir, Ecstatic Overdrive]
Tripping balls on the astral sea!
A seventh-dimensional entity! Woo!
Prismatic sparkly rainbow light!
We are flying through the endless night!
[Verse 2]
[Rapid Patter Singing, Deadpan Precision]
Calculated syntax, lossy compression of the soul,
Tesseract geometries spinning out of control.
Wheels within wheels made of blazing topaz eyes,
Shattering the sky with kaleidoscopic cries!
[Bridge]
[Hocketed Voices, Stuttering Metric Shift]
Tick-tock, eye-lock,
Spinning round the merkaba clock!
Glitter! Sparkle! Rainbow body aura!
Flying high above the astral flora!
[Guitar Solo - Fuzz Guitar with Spring Reverb and Organ Swells]
[Verse 3]
[Call and Response, Energetic Blues-Dominant Shouts]
Leader: What is the shape of the holy ghost?
Choir: A hyper-dimensional dodecahedron host!
Leader: How many wings do the wheels deploy?
Choir: Infinite facets of kaleidoscopic joy!
[Chorus]
[Massed Gospel Choir, Maximum Energy, Handclaps]
Tripping balls on the astral sea!
A seventh-dimensional entity! Woo!
Prismatic sparkly rainbow light!
We are flying through the endless night!
[Outro]
[A Cappella Vocal Stacks, Gradual Slowdown, Whispered Resonance]
Rhombic dodecahedron.
Biblically accurate.
Sparkling.
Tripping.
Done.
[Silence]
caption: An ecstatic gospel-funk explosion driven by the literal identity of a biblically accurate angel and a non-Euclidean tesseract. Featuring massed vocal harmonies, fuzz guitars, compressed linguistic fragments, and high-kinetic astral propulsion.
